headline.title: The largest orbital compute cluster is open for business
headline.summary: Kepler Communications has launched the largest orbital compute cluster, consisting of 40 GPUs in Earth orbit, to provide advanced computing capabilities. Its first customer is Sophia Space, which will utilize the cluster for its operations.

articles.title: E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
articles.summary: The paper introduces E3-TIR (Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning), a novel approach aimed at improving the training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Tool-Integrated Reasoning by addressing limitations in existing paradigms such as Zero-RL and SFT-then-RL. The proposed method seeks to enhance exploration efficiency and mitigate issues related to data costs and capability plateaus.

articles.title: GAN-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning for Semantic-Aware Resource Allocation in 6G Network Slicing
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach that combines Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) with Deep Reinforcement Learning to enhance resource allocation in 6G network slicing, addressing challenges such as semantic blindness and discrete action quantization. This method aims to optimize bandwidth usage and improve the efficiency of supporting diverse services in next-generation wireless networks.

articles.title: MARINER: A 3E-Driven Benchmark for Fine-Grained Perception and Complex Reasoning in Open-Water Environments
articles.summary: The MARINER benchmark has been introduced to enhance fine-grained visual understanding and complex reasoning in open-water environments, addressing a gap in existing research. It comprises 16,629 maritime images featuring 63 vessel categories and various dynamic maritime incidents, structured under the Entity-Environment-Event (3E) paradigm.

articles.title: 3D-VCD: Hallucination Mitigation in 3D-LLM Embodied Agents through Visual Contrastive Decoding
articles.summary: The article presents "3D-VCD," a method designed to mitigate hallucinations in 3D large language model (LLM) embodied agents by employing visual contrastive decoding. It highlights the limitations of existing hallucination mitigation techniques that primarily focus on 2D settings and emphasizes the unique challenges posed by 3D environments.

articles.title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Pre-training on Ascend NPUs
articles.summary: The article discusses the HiFloat4 format, a new low-precision training technique for language model pre-training on Ascend NPUs, which aims to reduce computational and memory costs associated with large foundation models. It highlights the successful application of 4-bit floating-point formats in linear GEMM operations to enhance efficiency in training and deployment.

articles.title: Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T: Multi-Dimensional Grouping for Ultra-High Energy Efficiency in Spiking Transformer
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach called Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T, which utilizes multi-dimensional grouping to enhance energy efficiency in Spiking Vision Transformers (S-ViTs). It addresses the limitations of existing training and inference methods for Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) by optimizing memory, accuracy, and energy consumption simultaneously.

articles.title: EquiformerV3: Scaling Efficient, Expressive, and General SE(3)-Equivariant Graph Attention Transformers
articles.summary: The article introduces EquiformerV3, a new generation of SE(3)-equivariant graph attention Transformers aimed at enhancing efficiency, expressivity, and generality for 3D atomistic modeling. This advancement addresses key challenges in the application of graph neural networks in large-scale scientific contexts.

articles.title: Persona-E$^2$: A Human-Grounded Dataset for Personality-Shaped Emotional Responses to Textual Events
articles.summary: The article introduces Persona-E$^2$, a new dataset designed to capture personality-shaped emotional responses to textual events, addressing the limitations of traditional affective computing that typically focuses on the writer's sentiment. By emphasizing the reader's perspective and individual personality differences, this dataset aims to enhance the understanding of emotional appraisals in natural language processing.

articles.title: Three Modalities, Two Design Probes, One Prototype, and No Vision: Experience-Based Co-Design of a Multi-modal 3D Data Visualization Tool
articles.summary: Researchers developed a multi-modal, web-native 3D data visualization tool aimed at improving accessibility for blind and low-vision individuals through Experience-Based Co-Design with expert co-designers. The project highlights the importance of inclusive design in STEM fields, where traditional visual representations often exclude BLV users.

articles.title: On the Representational Limits of Quantum-Inspired 1024-D Document Embeddings: An Experimental Evaluation Framework
articles.summary: The article discusses an experimental framework for evaluating quantum-inspired 1024-dimensional document embeddings, which aim to enhance semantic representation in information retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It contrasts these embeddings with traditional dense models derived from Large Language Models (LLMs), highlighting the potential benefits of leveraging geometric properties of Hilbert-like spaces.

articles.title: Learning General Representation of 12-Lead Electrocardiogram with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
articles.summary: A new study presents a joint-embedding predictive architecture for learning general representations of 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) using self-supervised learning (SSL) techniques. This approach addresses the challenge of limited labeled data in medical applications by enabling models to extract valuable insights from unlabeled ECG data.
